feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Helicopter crashes killing at least 3 people near an LA bus collision
entry.summary: A news helicopter crashed in a Los Angeles neighborhood on Tuesday and burst into flames, killing at least three people near the scene of where an SUV had slammed into a city bus, officials said.

entry.title: Judge blocks DHS from acting against a man over a harsh email to an ICE official
entry.summary: ICE agents turned up at David Streever's home over a harsh email he sent to an ICE official. Now a court order prevents the federal government from making additional threats against him.

entry.title: Turkish habit of stashing gold "under the pillow' hurts economy, government says
entry.summary: For years, Turks have stashed their gold at home against a raining day, mistrustful of banks. Now the government says that tradition hurts the economy

entry.title: Turks often keep gold as a hedge against inflation. It may be hurting Turkey's future
entry.summary: Billions of dollars worth of gold is held in Turkish households outside the banking system. The government aims to convince citizens to put it into the mainstream financial system to help the economy.

entry.title: State of U.S. democracy reaches new low, report finds
entry.summary: A new global democracy report finds the U.S. at its lowest level of democratic performance in the 50 years it has been measured.

entry.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
entry.summary: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.

entry.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close it, as judge again keeps Trump's name off
entry.summary: The board's vote to shutter the historic arts center came amid concerns about financial, structural problems.

entry.title: Prosecutors won't seek the death penalty for Nick Reiner
entry.summary: Los Angeles County District Attorney Nathan Hochman said his office spoke with Reiner's siblings and took their wishes into consideration in the decision.

entry.title: Republican Rep. Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war
entry.summary: Kentucky Republican Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Tuesday over the war in Iran.

entry.title: Tiny krill are turning up in deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why
entry.summary: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.
